description: A modern, minimalist spiral staircase with a white railing and treads. It's integrated into a semi-enclosed structure with grey, textured walls and glass panels. The staircase ascends from a light wood-planked floor. Above, a white platform extends, also featuring a white railing, suggesting an upper level or landing. A small black framed picture with an 'X' symbol is mounted on the back wall. The overall design is clean and geometric, with a focus on functional elegance.
